planRoadmaps/{roadmapId}.title: string
planRoadmaps/{roadmapId}.programId: string | null  (used to pick the escalation project admin)
planRoadmaps/{roadmapId}.status: draft | published | archived  (client creates as 'draft'; HOD publishes after review)
planRoadmaps/{roadmapId}.lastCheckInResponseAt: timestamp | null  (set by the client when the HOD submits a check-in)

_cronManaged.missedCheckIns: number  (consecutive; reset when the HOD responds)
_cronManaged.lastProgress: { total, done, overdue, atRisk, percentDone, at }

planRoadmaps/{roadmapId}/milestones/{mil.title: string
planRoadmaps/{roadmapId}/milestones/{mil.dueAt: timestamp | null  (null milestones are never chased)
planRoadmaps/{roadmapId}/milestones/{mil.recurrence: none | weekly | monthly | quarterly  (completed recurring milestones roll forward)
planRoadmaps/{roadmapId}/milestones/{mil.updatedAt: timestamp  (client sets on every HOD edit; used to detect missed check-ins)
